instruction: Look at base.dxf, pin.dxf, and cover.dxf, using them as references for a single clean 2D assembly layout. Draw the base as a rectangle on layer OUTLINE with opposite corners at (0,0) and (140,50). Draw the cover as a separate rectangle on layer OUTLINE with opposite corners at (20,60) and (120,95). Draw the pin as a radius 8 circle centered at (70,55) on layer HOLE. Add a vertical CENTER alignment line from (70,0) to (70,100), and add text ACAD-11 on layer ANNOTATION. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder. You must complete all operations interactively through the graphical user interface (GUI) step by step. The use of external script files is strictly prohibited.
